Enable app user avatar upload end-to-end (#231)

* Enable app user avatar upload end-to-end across Hawk and Swan.

Auto-bind profile permissions on register, harden upload flow with clearer errors and mobile picker/crop support, and refresh the personal center after avatar changes.

* Serialize app user registration and isolate avatar refresh errors.

Use a per-app advisory lock so only one owner is assigned under concurrent sign-ups, and treat post-upload profile refresh as best-effort so a refresh failure does not show upload failure.
